verdict.rationale: CockroachDB ships its source on GitHub and documents local installation (Homebrew) and running your own nodes via `cockroach start-single-node` and `cockroach demo`. The docs also refer explicitly to "CockroachDB self-hosted clusters" with backup/restore features, so the core product can clearly run on your own infrastructure. Community reports add real caveats: even free self-hosted users need an annual license key, telemetry is mandatory, and some features have historically been enterprise-gated. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-node production self-hosted deployment in the pack, clarity on license-key and telemetry requirements, independent hands-on self-hosting corroboration.
